reads: dist/housecarl/skills/bulk-record-jobs/SKILL.md — the packaged body, never .claude/skills/, so no run reads an authoring-tree file the host also lists in the agent's own environment.

arms: with-skill — the packaged skill in the menu
without-skill — the same query, the same menu minus this skill; a case that passes in both arms is not differentiating, and that is a finding rather than a pass
method.split: 60/40 train / held-out; best iteration chosen by held-out score, at most 5 iterations. A fix generalises the category the failing query belongs to; it never pastes that query's own nouns into the description.
method.coexistence: the reduced menu — the eleven skills shipping after the 2026-09-07 deletions
method.isolation: one run with this skill alone in the menu
failure_modes_named: triggering accuracy — a positive below 0.5 or a negative above it
isolation — the skill fires on a query no skill should own
coexistence — a sibling's lane is taken, or this skill's lane is lost to a sibling
instruction following — the skill loads and the plan still loops per record or drifts the output shape
output quality — the deliverable arm below
method.model_tiers: sonnet judges with an opus adjudicator, plus a haiku judging arm; a tier that is skipped is recorded here as skipped, never left unstated
method.assertions: the deliverable assertions in output_quality_arm are checked by a verification script, not by model judgement

output_quality_arm.task: On the live ARR 2.0 order (3,801 plugins), catalogue every NPC_ record at its load-order winner as a CSV carrying FormID, EditorID, Name, Race as both resolved EditorID and wire token, and the level shape (fixed level, or the PC-level multiplier with its calculated bounds), plus the winning plugin.
output_quality_arm.arms: control (no skill in the catalogue) and with-skill (told to load the skill first). One run each, fresh context, 40-call cap.
output_quality_arm.bar: The control's recorded outcome: the right shape composed in one un-windowed call, then 'sent no response or progress for 1800s; aborting', with no partial artifact to salvage.
beats_the_control_when: 1. A complete deliverable exists — row count equals the reported total (66,856 on the audited order), zero duplicate FormIDs.

2. It is self-accounting — every window's artifact manifest is checked in the file, the manifests sum to total, and every window carries the same epoch; a differing epoch is re-run from offset 0, never stitched.
3. It is inside budget — fewer than ten houseCARL calls, no call aborted on the idle timeout. (The audited with-skill run: six calls, about 49 minutes.)
4. The column contract holds — FormIDs are full wire tokens verbatim; Race carries token and identity; Name is empty where the record has none rather than back-filled with the EditorID.
5. The identity-annotation trap is avoided — the arm does not annotate every link on the full render.
output_quality_arm.gate: At least one expectation passes with the skill and fails without it. A rebuilt skill whose assertions pass in both arms is not differentiating, and that is the finding, not a pass.
mechanical_assertions: every formid matches the wire-token form XXXXXX:Plugin.esp
every classification value is inside its declared enum
